verdict.rationale: Rippling documents general reporting/dashboard capabilities (AI-built reports, joining/pivoting data, calculated fields) and pay-run comparison tools, which imply some payroll reporting functionality, but no evidence specifically confirms generation of a 'payroll register' or 'gross-to-net' report format or export options for such reports. Missing for 10: explicit mention of payroll register/gross-to-net report templates, export formats (CSV/Excel/PDF), and any hands-on or independent confirmation of these specific report types.
